supplements: tools/bazel/test_classification.json (bazel_graph, 95 modules at classification); that file is reused read-only
method: Read of the five test modules added since the bazel_graph classification (git diff --name-status f44f962..549a14d -- tests/ for the first three at the lane baseline; git diff --name-status 549a14d..0ea22c3 -- tests/ for test_take_intake and test_timing_calibration, added on main and classified after the Phase 4 rebase): every FFmpeg/FFprobe, node/pnpm/git, artifacts/ and web/ or site/ reference located with grep, then the surrounding code read to separate real execution from string fixtures. The executed behaviour under Bazel of the first three is recorded in docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261007-s3/bazel_full-full-run.json; the two rebase additions were not part of that run (see its rebase_onto_main section). Root classified test_auth_token_s3 and test_stems_estimate at integration (merged on main after the lane returned) by reading their imports, subprocess calls and paths. Root classified test_s3g_tool_admission at root_admission_g (2026-10-07) by reading its imports, subprocess calls and paths: no FFmpeg, node, pnpm or git; workspace-artifacts for the reason recorded.

claim_classes.behaviour_under_bazel: measured by the single full run (bazel_full-full-run.json)

reasons.test_take_intake: builds synthetic .mov fixtures with a real FFmpeg (lavfi testsrc2) and runs scripts/take_intake.py, which probes and decodes them; media tests skip with reason ffmpeg_unavailable when neither FFMPEG/FFPROBE nor the hash-pinned Nix path resolves
reasons.test_timing_calibration: test_p2_cli_analyze_on_wav decodes a generated WAV through FFmpeg via scripts/media.py; skipUnless FFMPEG and FFPROBE are exported (pass --test_env=FFMPEG --test_env=FFPROBE)
reasons.test_stems_estimate: M7a renders a synthetic 32.7 Hz excerpt through FFmpeg resampling (FFMPEG env or PATH); the rest run on a temporary root with fake separators and no FFmpeg

reasons.test_public_site_s3: runs `node site/scripts/leak-scan.mjs`, `pnpm run check`/`pnpm run build` in site/ (skips when site/node_modules is absent) and `git ls-files`
reasons.test_s3_tool_admission: runs `git ls-files -- models` when git resolves (unchecked, never passed, when absent)
reasons.test_take_intake: falls back to the hash-pinned Nix FFmpeg/FFprobe path when FFMPEG/FFPROBE are unset, runs `git init` (skips git_unavailable on failure), and scripts/take_intake.py resolves git from PATH for its tracked-path check
reasons.test_auth_token_s3: starts the built adapter-node server with `node serve.js` in tailnet mode and a loopback JWKS server

reasons.test_public_site_s3: removes and rebuilds the checkout's site/build and site/.svelte-kit through pnpm when site/node_modules is installed (the site analogue of the web/ criterion)
lists artifacts/runs/ (and the main checkout's) to build its private-identifier needles
reasons.test_s3_tool_admission: starts scripts/beat_this_compare.py against artifacts/runs/absent-s3-admission and reads models/ (both ignored, undeclared trees)
reasons.test_take_intake: creates and removes artifacts/s2/take_intake/tests-<pid>/ (fixtures, state roots), writes artifacts/s2/take_intake/test-results.json in tearDownModule, and asserts artifacts/runs/take-intake-x is never created; the gated e2e case (TAKE_INTAKE_E2E=1) also writes artifacts/take-intake/
reasons.test_timing_calibration: the opt-in sealed evaluations (TIMING_CALIBRATION_S3_SEALED_EVAL=1 / _R2=1, not passed by Bazel unless --test_env names them) write artifacts/s2/timing_calibration/sealed/; default cases use temporary directories only. Tagged conservatively so a result is never cached across an artifacts/ change
reasons.test_auth_token_s3: writes its case table and server logs under artifacts/s2/auth_token/<stamp>/
reasons.test_s3g_tool_admission: starts scripts/stems_estimate.py (directly and through the MCP server) against artifacts/runs/absent-s3g-admission and scripts/take_intake.py plan on an absent repository-relative source (both refuse before reading or writing; ignored, undeclared trees); every other case uses temporary directories

reasons.test_web_house_stack_s3: reads web/package.json, web/pnpm-lock.yaml and web/e2e fixtures (and site/ manifests when present)
reasons.test_auth_token_s3: requires a current web/build (skips when absent or older than web sources); does not rebuild it

site_tree_readers.note: //site is not a data dependency of the Python tests, for the same reason as //web (loading it needs the npm lock translation). Every module that reads site/ is already tagged no-cache through workspace-artifacts or reads-web-tree, so no stale cached result can hide a site/ change. A dedicated reads-site-tree tag would need a change to tools/bazel/python.bzl (not owned); not requested because the no-cache property already holds.

manual.note: No manual tag is added (contract section 4.2).
